message: This also contains acetaminophen, like a medicine already in your library — taking both risks exceeding the daily limit. Please confirm the combined dose with your pharmacist before taking both.
This is an NSAID, like aspirin already in your library — combining two blood-thinning-adjacent medicines can increase bleeding risk. Please confirm with your pharmacist before taking both.
NSAIDs like this one can reduce how well amlodipine controls blood pressure. Please confirm with your pharmacist before taking both regularly.
NSAIDs like this one can reduce the effect of losartan and affect kidney function when combined. Please confirm with your pharmacist before taking both.
Combining this antibiotic with a statin already in your library can, in rare cases, increase muscle-related side effects. Please confirm with your pharmacist before taking both.
This may modestly change how your statin is processed. Please confirm with your pharmacist if you notice unusual side effects.
